final_800_scope: No final32 or final64 single-Weir 800/s probe was fully qualified. All failures match sessions admission; workers8 ×16 allows128 in-flight RPCs versus32/64 session capacities. This test proves connection concentration under synchronized same-key bursts, not general dispersed-key batching capacity.
